cases.heading: Settings
cases.prose: =setq= gives a setting a value, written as in Emacs. Numbers can be computed.

cases.heading: Lists
cases.prose: =add-to-list= and =push= add to a list you have set. A third argument of =t= adds at the end.
cases.init:
(setq my-list nil my-other nil)
(add-to-list 'my-list 'a)
(add-to-list 'my-list 'b t)
(add-to-list 'my-list 'a)
(push "z" my-other)

cases.heading: A variable that was never set
cases.prose: =add-to-list= and =push= need a variable that has a value. On one that was never set, Emacs reports that it is void, and the form after it still runs. The variables the app knows, such as =org-modules= and =org-capture-templates=, always have one.

errors: Symbol's value as variable is void: never-set
Symbol's value as variable is void: never-set-either

cases.heading: Functions and computed values
cases.prose: All of Lisp is there to compute a value: =defun=, =let=, loops, =format=. What the init defines is there for diary entries and holiday lists too.
cases.init:
(defun double (n) (* 2 n))
(setq doubled (let ((acc nil))
                (dolist (x '(1 2 3)) (push (double x) acc))
                (nreverse acc)))
(setq label (mapconcat #'identity '("x" "y") "-"))

cases.heading: Holidays
cases.prose: The holiday lists are variables. This switches the general holidays off and adds a day of your own. See =holidays.org= for every entry and flag.

cases.heading: A capture template
cases.prose: Templates are read as Emacs reads them and appear beside the JSON ones. See =capture-templates.org=.

cases.heading: LaTeX settings
cases.prose: The LaTeX export reads the ox-latex variables, among them the source block backend and the table options.

cases.heading: A function as a setting
cases.prose: Some settings name a function. =org-latex-format-headline-function= formats every section title; the Agenda settings such as =org-agenda-cmp-user-defined= work the same way. The expressions below call the function directly.
cases.init:
(setq org-latex-format-headline-function
      (lambda (todo todo-type priority text tags info)
        (concat (if todo (format "[%s] " todo) "") (upcase text))))
show: (funcall org-latex-format-headline-function nil nil nil "Plan" nil nil)

cases.heading: When a form fails
cases.prose: A form that fails shows Emacs's message in the status line, and the forms after it still run.
